title: A 1-homogeneous measure finite on the unit ball has no atom at the origin (parent step 6)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let μ be a measure on the Borel sets of ℝ^P such that μ(λW) = λ·μ(W) for every λ > 0 and every open W ⊆ ℝ^P (where λW := {λx : x ∈ W}), and μ(B_1(0)) < ∞. Then μ({0}) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → μ ((fun x => lam • x) '' W) = ENNReal.ofReal lam * μ W) → μ (ball (0 : Euclid P) 1) ≠ ∞ → μ {0} = 0
